GCAP3053.description: This course will systematically introduce the history, current situation and trend of philanthropy and social service development in Mainland China. The students will have a preliminary understanding of the current situation of China’s NGOs through multiple methods. After learning theories related to community development, discussing the needs of different communities, and learning from NGO staff and service users, students get to know the work content of NGOs. After 6 weeks of in-classroom learning, that emphasizes on critical thinking and adopts multiple perspectives, students will be enabled to form their own views about philanthropy development in mainland China.

GCAP3043.description: This course aims to provide theoretical perspectives, methods and tools for students to understand the connection of man and nature. Starting from the history, current situation and trend of sustainable development and environmental participation in mainland China, it equips students with conceptual and practical knowledge of environmental challenge, environmental collaboration, environmental communication, environmental education, participation and awareness.

WPEX1013.description: This course provides an introduction to the process philosophy of Alfred North Whitehead, which is considered as the philosophical foundation of Whole Person Education in the western cultural tradition. It aims to provide students with an understanding of the central concepts of Whitehead's philosophy, including his views on ontology, cosmology, and epistemology. The course will explore Whitehead's concepts of process, creativity, and the relationship between the individual and the whole. The course will examine the key texts and ideas of Whitehead's philosophy and consider their relevance to contemporary debates in metaphysics, epistemology, education and ethics.

WPEX2023.description: The course equips students with philanthropy knowledge, attitude and skills, to broaden their horizons and cultivate multiple understanding of society, and to develop them into tolerant and thoughtful citizens with philanthropic spirit.

WPEX2033.description: The course aims to develop students’ understanding of environmental sustainability issues from local to global scales, and to raise students’ environmental awareness and responsibility in daily life. The course provides students with experiences applying knowledge and skills that are used to explore and investigate a wide range of environmental issues faced at campus or in the community.

WPEX2013.description:
As China's market economy started in the early 90, contemporary ink painting rapidly developing and growing form of a special painting form. It has been designed to help students in both "image” and " abstract " on the basis of the concept of modeling and training " image " - style modeling concepts and explore new formal language of contemporary Chinese ink painting. In the course content, Chinese literati painting technique combination with western forms of content, not only can learn the most representative Chinese calligraphy, and will learn through an integrated combination of material and ink painting. The ultimate aim is to hope that our students will be trained to a broader cultural perspective to look at the traditional national culture in the world.
*Note: Students need to bring or buy their own materials. (50RMB)
WPEX2013.description_cn:
当代水墨，是90年代初随着中国市场经济起步、发展而迅速成长起来的一门特殊绘画形式。该课程旨在帮助同学们在既有的“具象”和“抽象”造型观念的基础上，培养“意象”式的造型观念并探索当代中国水墨新的形式语言。在课程内容上，把中国文人画手法与西方表现形式内容进行了结合，不但可以学习到最具代表性的中国书法，还会学习到通过综合材料与水墨相结合的绘画。最终目的是希望我们培养出来的学生将会以更宽广的世界文化眼光来审视民族文化传统。
*注意：本课程学生需支付50元材料成本费用。

UCHL1013.description: Badminton is a skill dominated by the type of net - wide antagonism of the event, its entertainment, simplicity, exercise and other characteristics by the majority of students like. Badminton sports can develop students' coordination and agility, and cultivate students' good qualities such as fair competition, tenacious struggle, calm and decisive, unity and cooperation. The course is taught in the form of a combination of 28 class hours of in-class practice and 20 class hours of extracurricular practice. This course will familiarize students with the basic skills, tactics, rules of the game and the rules of the referee. Students will be led to apply fundamental sports science knowledge in analyzing and enhancing their performance. The course provides students with an understanding of the training methods for badminton, according to the project characteristics of the badminton introduces general functional training and sports injury prevention and recovery. Moreover, the course provides students with knowledge on healthy lifestyle, suggestions on how to develop an exercise habit, and how racket sports such as badminton can contribute as life-long physical activities.
UCHL1013.description_cn: 羽毛球是一项以球技为主的隔网对抗型项目，其娱乐性、简洁性、运动性等特点受到广大学生的喜爱。羽毛球运动可以培养学生的协调性和敏捷性，培养学生公平竞争、顽强奋斗、冷静果断、团结合作等良好素质。本课程以28学时的课堂实践和20学时的课外实践相结合的形式进行教学，使学生熟悉足球的基本技术、战术、比赛规则和裁判规则。学生将被引导运用基本的运动科学知识来分析和提高他们的能力。此外，本课程让学生了解羽毛球运动的训练方法，根据羽毛球运动的项目特点，介绍一般功能训练和运动损伤的预防与恢复。该课程为学生提供健康生活方式的知识，如何养成运动习惯的建议，以及羽毛球等使用球拍类运动如何成为终身体育活动。

UCHL1023.description: This course aims to acquaint students with the basic knowledge of basketball. It also provides students with an understanding of basic nutrition in relation to healthy living. Students will learn how to apply basic sports science knowledge in analyzing techniques and plays. In addition, through group games students will have opportunities to appreciate teamwork in basketball. Upon completion of the course, students will develop a sense of confidence in participating in basketball; develop an appreciation of different offensive and defensive plays of the game; understand the importance of physical fitness as it relates to team sports; and adopt an active healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1023.description_cn: 本课程旨在使学生掌握篮球的基本知识，让学生了解与健康生活有关的基本营养学知识。学生将学习如何运用基本的运动科学知识来分析技术和比赛。此外，通过小组比赛，学生将有机会观赏篮球团队合作。完成课程后，学生将提高参与篮球运动的信心；培养对不同进攻和防守战术的鉴赏能力；了解身体健康在团队运动中的重要性；采取积极健康的生活方式。

UCHL1033.description: This course teaches swimming theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1033.description_cn: 本课程讲授游泳的理论与战术、体育锻炼的方法与手段、科学健康的生活方式、运动损伤的预防与康复，培养学生的体育意识，为学生如何积极健康地生活提供理论和技术支持，使学生能够积极、有目的地参加体育活动。

UCHL1043.description: This course teaches swimming theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1043.description_cn: 课程旨在教授学生拉拉操的各种技术技能，基本规则，使学生能够作为拉拉队员表演。通过每节课的学习，学生逐渐获得相关知识和经验，能够在娱乐或比赛中与其他拉拉队队员进行表演和合作。通过学习，促进学生的身体健康，培养终身锻炼的理念，体会团队合作的快乐，并通过啦啦操活动提高学生的体质和健康水平。这类课程的核心是通过培养积极健康生活方式的知识、技能和态度，有目的地让学生参与体育活动。

UCHL1053.description: This course teaches swimming theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1053.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学员各种气功的技术技能，使学员在练习气功的过程中，能够熟练地运用各种基本功。通过学习，学生逐渐掌握进学生的身心健康，提高学生的体质和健康水平。它通过知识、技能和态度来学生培养积极健康的生活方式的，使学生参与体育活动。

UCHL1063.description: The course aims to help students develop the lifelong-exercise habit and interest, providing brand-new eyesight of fitness, grasp practical training skills and improve their health level scientifically. Students will gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience of weightlifting and fitness through each lesson. In addition, the training plan for students will be modulated according to the prior fitness level of students to make sure each student obtains certain improvement. After accomplishing the fitness lesson, students will cherish their health more. They can not only learn fitness training skills, but also make a training plan to improve their health level safely and effectively.
UCHL1063.description_cn: 本课程旨在帮助学生培养终身运动的习惯和兴趣，提供全新的健身视野，掌握实用的训练技巧，科学地提高学生的健康水平。通过每节课的学习，学生逐渐掌握举重运动和健身知识和经验。此外，根据学生的前期体能水平调整训练计划，确保每位学生都有一定的提高。完成健身课程后，学生会更加珍惜自己的健康。他们不仅可以学习健身训练技能，还可以制定训练计划，安全有效地提高自己的健康水平。

UCHL1073.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills of orienteering, and the basic rules and strategies that enable students to practice and perform orienteering. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience of orienteering through each class and practice, and enable students to perform and cooperate with other students for recreation or orienteering competition. Upon completion of the course, students will develop a sense of confidence in participating in the orienteering sport; develop an appreciation of the sport; understand the importance of physical fitness as it relates to the sport; and adopt an active healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1073.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学生定向运动的各种技术技能，使学生能够练习和运用定向运动的基本规则和策略。通过每节课学习和每一次练习，学生逐渐掌握定向越野知识和经验，能够表演和通过与其他学生合作进行娱乐或定向越野比赛。完成课程后，学生能有信心地参加定向越野运动；培养对这项运动的兴趣；了解这项运动对身体健康的重要性；采取积极健康的生活方式。

UCHL1083.description: Pilates is a physical exercise that helps people return to their busy lives with a sense of energy. It develops a disciplined and healthy lifestyle through physical training. This course is designed to help students understand the benefits of Pilates breathing, stretching and strength exercises, and to learn these motion techniques. The students will master the exercise of Pilates at basic and intermediate level, and also master proper stretching methods. The course will develop students' ability to focus, enhance their flexibility, especially spinal flexibility, improve their core control, shape their form, and improve their temperament. The course will also cultivate students' ability of innovation, sense of teamwork, sense of competition, and sense of art. Out-of-class assignments will be given to incorporate the benefits of Pilates into students` daily life, for example taking Pilates breaths, doing the roll up, or doing balance exercises three to five times a day.
UCHL1083.description_cn: 普拉提是一种体育锻炼，可以帮助人们在忙碌的生活中恢复精力。它通过体育锻炼培养一种纪律和健康的生活方式。本课程旨在帮助学生了解普拉提呼吸，伸展和力量练习的好处，并学习这些运动技术。学生将掌握初级和中级普拉提的练习，掌握适当的拉伸方法。该课程将培养学生的专注能力，增强他们的柔韧性，特别是脊柱柔韧性，提高他们的核心控制，塑造他们的形态，改善他们的气质。培养学生的创新能力、团队意识、竞争意识和艺术意识。课外作业将把普拉提的好处融入到学生的日常生活中，例如，每天做三到五次普拉提呼吸，做卷腹，或做平衡练习。

UCHL1093.description: This course teaches rugby theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1093.description_cn: 本课程讲授橄榄球的理论与战术、体育锻炼的方法与手段、科学健康的生活方式、运动损伤的预防与康复，培养学生的体育意识，为学生如何积极健康地生活提供理论和技术支持，使学生能够积极、有目的地参与体育活动。

UCHL1103.description: This course aims to help students adopt a healthy lifestyle through physical exercise, while learning and practicing self defence, including self defence concepts, self defence common sense and self defence skills. To learn unarmed defence can minimize damages in emergency situations, and students can apply the taught self defence skills for the purpose of self-protection when in danger. Through active practical experiences, the course also expects to promote the idea of lifelong exercises, and improve students’ fitness and wellness through the self defence activity.
UCHL1103.description_cn: 本课程旨在通过体育锻炼帮助学生养成健康的生活方式，同时学习和练习防身术，包括防身术概念、常识和技能。学习徒手防御可以在紧急情况下最大限度地减少损失，学生可以运用所教的防身技能在危险中进行自我保护。通过学习，该课程还希望推广终身锻炼的理念，并通过防身术活动提高学生的体质和健康。

UCHL1113.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills in table tennis and the basic rules of the game. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience in table tennis through each lesson, and enable students to play by themselves for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises and improves fitness and wellness of students through table tennis activity.
UCHL1113.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学生各种乒乓球技术及基本比赛规则。通过每节课的学习，学生逐渐掌握乒乓球知识和经验，能够享受这项运动或比赛。课程还推广终身锻炼的理念，通过乒乓球活动提高学生的体质和健康水平。

UCHL1123.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills in table tennis and the basic rules of the game. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience in table tennis through each lesson, and enable students to play by themselves for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises and improves fitness and wellness of students through table tennis activity.
UCHL1123.description_cn: 本课程旨在透过参与网球运动，让学生了解健康的生活方式及如何积极运动。课程不仅会介绍网球的基本技巧，还会提供不同的游戏，让学生在课堂上活跃起来，体验锻炼的好处。网球是一项很好的有氧运动，可以提高反应能力、平衡能力和协调性。学生将在课堂上通过任务或游戏体验兴奋和快乐。与同学组成团队也会加强学生的社会联系。完成课程后，学生应养成锻炼的习惯，这对改善和保持身体健康至关重要。

UCHL1133.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills in Yoga and the basic rules to practice Yoga in different environments. The course also intends to help students gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience, and enable students to practice Yoga by themselves for health promotion or sports competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also expects to promote the idea of lifelong exercises and improve fitness and wellness of students through Yoga and Asana practice.
UCHL1133.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学生瑜伽的各种技术技能，以及在不同环境下练习瑜伽的基本规则。课程还帮助学生逐渐获得丰富的知识和经验，使学生能够自己练习瑜伽，以促进自身健康或参加体育比赛。课程还希望通过瑜伽和体式练习，促进终身锻炼的理念，提高学生的健身和健康。

UCHL1143.description: Good health-related aerobic dancing and regular dancing activity are important for optimal wellness. They can not only help improve strength and endurance as well as stretch and flexibility, but also promote quality of life and well-being. This course aims to help students to acquire recognition and appreciation of the beauty of the body, and a good understanding and response to music. It also provides students with an understanding of the principles of a healthy lifestyle for achieving physical health and well-being by participating in Aerobic Dancing. Upon completion of this course, students will gain practical experience in a variety of basic dance movements including Zumba, Jazz, Salsa, and have a good understanding of a healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1143.description_cn: 有氧舞蹈不仅有助于提高力量和耐力以及伸展和灵活性，还可以提高生活质量和幸福感。本课程旨在帮助学生获得对身体美的认可和欣赏，以及对音乐的理解和反应。同时，让学生了解通过参加有氧舞蹈可以达到身体健康和幸福的目的。完成本课程后，学生将学会各种基本舞蹈动作，包括尊巴舞、爵士舞、萨尔萨舞，并对健康的生活方式有很好的理解。

UCHL1153.description: This course aims to provide students with a basic understanding of a healthy lifestyle and ways to develop a physically active life by participating in football. The course will introduce various technical skills in football and the basic rules of the game. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience in football through each lesson, and enable students to play by themselves for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises and improves fitness and wellness of students through football activity.
UCHL1153.description_cn: 本课程旨在让学生了解健康的生活方式以及通过参加足球运动来拓展体育活动。本课程将介绍足球的各种技术技能和比赛的基本规则，帮助学生学习足球知识和获得相应的技能，使学生能够自己踢球进行娱乐或比赛。该课程还推广终身锻炼的理念，通过足球活动提高学生的体质和健康。

UCHL1163.description: This course provides student with knowledge of body controls, being flexible, and proper body posture that relates and contributes to well-being and healthy lifestyle of individuals. Students will be instructed to comprehend skills using big exercise ball. The body training and exercises on an unstable and bouncing ball will improve core strength and body control. Additionally, it contributes to the correction of body posture and increases flexibility and body balance. Meditation exercises with fitness ball will not just bring relaxation of mood and release of stress, but also ensure movement flow and coherency, which ignite the harmony between mind and body. Moreover, this course is designed to provide students with an understanding of the principles of a healthy lifestyle for achieving physical health and wellness.
UCHL1163.description_cn: 本课程为学生提供身体掌控、灵活度和身体动作的知识，这些知识与个人的幸福感和健康生活方式有关并有助于提高他们健康的生活方式。该课程将指导学生理解使用大型健身球的技巧。在不稳定和弹跳的球上进行身体训练和锻炼，提高核心力量和身体控制能力。此外，它有助于纠正身体姿势，增加灵活性和身体平衡。健身球冥想练习不仅能放松心情，释放压力，还能保证动作的流畅性和连贯性，点燃身心和谐。此外，本课程旨在让学生了解实现身体健康的健康生活方式的理论。

UCHL1173.description: The course aims to teach students various technical skills in Ultimate Frisbee and the basic rules of the game. The course also intends to help students to gradually acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience in Ultimate Frisbee through each lesson, and enable students to play by themselves for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises and improves fitness and wellness of students through Ultimate Frisbee activity.
UCHL1173.description_cn: 该课程旨在教授学生极限飞盘的各种技术技能和游戏的基本规则。通过学习，学生逐渐掌握满意的极限飞盘知识和经验，能够自行进行娱乐或比赛。课程还推广终身锻炼的理念，并通过极限飞盘活动提高学生的体能和健康水平。

UCHL1183.description: The course aims to teach students the technical skills and basic knowledge of kayaking and similar boating sport activities. It further intends to encourage students to adopt a positive attitude and healthy lifestyle, cultivate students' self-motivation, self-knowledge and team spirit, and improve their physical abilities, including reaction, balance, coordination and endurance. Students experience excitement and pleasure through challenges and games, while teamwork, perseverance, leadership and a sense of adventure will be promoted through this process.
UCHL1183.description_cn: 本课程旨在教授学生皮划艇及类似划船运动的技术技巧和基本知识，鼓励学生养成积极向上的生活态度和健康的生活方式，培养学生的自我激励、自我认知和团队精神，提高学生的反应能力、平衡能力、协调能力和耐力。学生通过挑战游戏体验课程中的兴奋和快乐，同时团队合作、毅力、领导能力和冒险意识将在这个过程中得到提升。

UCHL1193.description: Outdoor leadership is to challenge oneself to lead a team, face adversity, and savor the relationships formed in the wild. This course begins with the fundamentals, forming a foundation that enables students to step forward with the skills and knowledge to lead others toward a common goal. The extended outdoor course environment provides an ideal opportunity for developing leadership skills through a progression where each student observes, applies, and discusses leadership techniques. Upon completion of the course, students will be able to serve a team in a variety of roles of leadership; demonstrate good outdoor leadership skills, including expedition behavior, communication, judgement and decision making, tolerance for adversity and uncertainty; take responsibility for the well-being of themselves and others; understand the relationship between human beings and nature; and adopt an active healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1193.description_cn: 户外领导力是挑战自己，带领团队，面对逆境，享受野外生活的一门课程。本课程从基础知识开始开始学习，使学生能够凭借技能和知识向前迈进，带领他人实现共同目标。扩展的户外课程环境为每个学生提供了一个发展领导技能的机会。完成课程后，学生将能够为团队服务，担任各种领导角色；表现出良好的户外领导技能，包括探险行为、沟通、判断和决策、对逆境和不确定性的忍耐力；对自己和他人的健康负责；理解人与自然的关系；采取积极健康的生活方式。

UCHL1203.description: The course aims to enable students to learn and master basic knowledge and skills of sport climbing, and become proficient in climbing safety techniques and climbing safety management. Students will achieve a better physical and mental state when participating in climbing activities, and understand the related knowledge of climbing training, and be able to develop a basic training plan for themselves. After completing the course, students will be able to understand the benefits of sport climbing toward improving health and daily physical exercise. Students will develop a sense of confidence in participating in sport climbing, develop an appreciation of the sport, understand the importance of physical fitness as it relates to the sport, and adopt an active healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1203.description_cn: 本课程旨在使学生学习和掌握运动攀岩的基本知识和技能，熟练掌握攀岩安全技术和攀岩安全管理。使学生在参加攀岩活动时达到更好的身心状态，了解攀岩训练的相关知识，能够为自己制定基本的训练计划。完成课程后，学生将能够了解运动攀岩对改善健康和日常体育锻炼的好处。学生将在参与运动攀岩时建立信心，培养对这项运动的欣赏，了解身体健康的重要性。

UCHL1213.description: The course is offered to students whose mobility/sensory/health needs special teaching and learning attention. It aims to teach students various technical skills of weight and fitness training, and the basic safety rules that enable them to operate different weight equipment. The course also provides an understanding of the benefits of the Fitness exercise for students with mobility/sensory/health needs, skills to participate in exercise, and knowledge of rehabilitation. Through positive practical experiences, the course also promotes the idea of lifelong exercises, and improves students’ fitness and wellness through special weight and fitness exercises.
UCHL1213.description_cn: 该课程面向身心需要特殊教学和关注的学生。它旨在向学生传授健身训练的各种技术技能，使他们能够掌握操作不同重量设备的基本安全规则。该课程还为有运动/感官/健康特殊需求的学生提供了了解健身锻炼、参与锻炼的技能和康复的相关知识。该课程还推广终身锻炼的理念，并通过特殊的锻炼方式提高学生的体质和健康。

UCHL1223.description: This course aims to help students learn various technical skills in Dragon and Lion Dance, including dance movements and routines, team work, and basic drum play. At the same time, the course introduces the cultural background and philosophy of Dragon and Lion Dance, and emphasizes sportsmanship values, such as fair-play, mutual respects, solidarity and friendship. Through positive practical experiences, the course also expects to promote the idea of lifelong exercises, as students enjoy the happiness of team work, and improve their fitness and wellness through the Dragon and Lion Dance activities.
UCHL1223.description_cn: 本课程旨在帮助学生学习舞龙舞狮的各种技术技能，包括动作和策略、团队合作和基本的打鼓方式。同时，课程介绍舞龙舞狮的文化背景和哲学理论，强调公平竞争、相互尊重、团结友爱等体育精神价值观。该课程还希望推广终身锻炼的理念，让学生享受团队合作的快乐，通过舞龙舞狮活动提高他们的体能和健康。

UCHL1243.description:
This course aims to acquaint students with the basic knowledge of golf. It also provides students with an understanding of basic nutrition in relation to healthy living. Students will learn how to apply basic golf techniques, tactics, swing principles and fundamental sports science knowledge in analyzing techniques and plays. In addition, by watching and participating in golf competitions, students will have the opportunity to appreciate and experience the team cooperation, golf spirit and sports spirit of golf. This course will cultivate students' interest and confidence in participating in golf; cultivate students' appreciation of different offensive and defensive tactics in the game; let students understand the importance of physical fitness and learn to adopt a positive and healthy lifestyle. It will lay a good foundation for students' physical, psychological and social adaptability in the future.
*Students should make sure that they do not have class an hour before the start time of this course. Besides, students should pay the course fee RMB 800 (transporation, rent).
UCHL1243.description_cn:
本课程旨在使学生熟悉高尔夫的基本知识，使学生了解与健康生活有关的相关营养知识。学生将学习如何将基本的高尔夫技术、战术、挥杆原理和基本的体育科学知识应用于分析技术和比赛中。此外，通过观看和参加高尔夫比赛，学生将有机会欣赏和体验高尔夫的团队合作、高尔夫精神和体育精神。本课程将培养学生参与高尔夫运动的兴趣和信心；培养学生对比赛中不同攻防战术的鉴赏力；让学生了解身体素质的重要性，并学会积极健康的生活方式。它将为学生未来的身体、心理和社会适应能力奠定良好的基础。
*学生需支付课程费用包括交通费、高尔夫球场地租赁费。

UCHL1263.description: This course teaches swimming theory and tactics, methods and means of physical exercise, scientific and healthy lifestyle, sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, to cultivate students' sports awareness, provide theoretical and technical support for students on how to live an active and healthy life, and enable students to actively and purposefully participate in sports activities.
UCHL1263.description_cn: 本课程讲授游泳的理论与战术、体育锻炼的方法与手段、科学健康的生活方式、运动损伤的预防与康复，培养学生的体育意识，为学生如何积极健康地生活提供理论和技术支持，使学生能够积极、有目的地参加体育活动。

UCHL1303.description: This course aims to help students adopt a healthy lifestyle through physical exercise. Apart from learning the archery technique, students will benefit from this course physically and mentally, such as shaping an upright body-gesture, strengthening their physical health, embodying a positive attitude and ways of being a human, and nourishing an essential personality, which is calm, concentrated, patient, courageous and self-motivated.
UCHL1303.description_cn: 本课程旨在通过体育锻炼，帮助学生养成健康的生活方式。在学习射箭技术的同时，学员在身心上也将受益，如塑造端正的身体姿态，增强体质，体现积极向上的做人态度和做人方式，培养冷静、专注、耐心、勇敢、上进的基本人格。

UCHL1313.description: Salsa is one of the artistic activities which improve students’ healthy lifestyle and well-being.  Progressive Salsa training will brush up students’ cardiovascular performance and rhythmic proficiency as well as interpersonal social skills. The course provides a platform by developing the fundamentals of body movements and musical knowledge in order to flourish student’s physical and mental well-being with rhythm-body awareness.  Students would also develop a sense of healthy cultural appreciation through mutual exploration, musical responds, and social etiquette. In sum, Salsa helps students enlarge social circle, networking, and establish a healthy lifestyle.
UCHL1313.description_cn: 莎莎舞是提高学生健康生活方式和幸福感的运动之一。萨尔萨渐进式训练将提高学生的心血管功能、节奏熟练度以及人际社交技能。本课程提供了一个平台，通过学习基本的身体动作和音乐知识，以促进学生的身心健康与有节奏的控制身体意识。学生还将通过相互探索、音乐反应和社交礼仪培养文化欣赏。总而言之，莎莎舞能够帮助学生扩大社交圈，建立健康的生活方式。

UCHL1323.description: The course aims to teach students to learn various technical skills in Volleyball and the basic rules enable students to perform the essential skills when playing Volleyball. The course also intends to help students gradually to acquire a satisfactory level of knowledge and experience of Volleyball through each lesson, and enable students to perform and cooperate with other Volleyball players for recreation or competition. Through positive practical experiences, the course also expects to promote the idea of lifelong exercises, enjoy the happiness of team work, and improve fitness and wellness of students through Volleyball games.
UCHL1323.description_cn: 本课程旨在教会学生学习排球的各种技术技能，基本规则，使学生能够掌握基本技能。该课程还旨在帮助学生逐渐获得排球知识和经验，使学生能够在娱乐或比赛中与其他排球运动员进行表演和合作。通过实践，本课程还希望推广终身锻炼的理念，享受团队合作的快乐，提高学生的体质和健康。
